Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.application.auth

package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.application.auth
Auth bounded context — application layer. Login / logout / change-password use cases plus the technical ports JwtTokenService, PasswordHasher, JwtDenylist. Populated by EPIC-03.
